continuation_plan.construction: Every candidate is independently reconstructed from W0. Scale only the specified L24 self_attn.o_proj output block (128 input columns per head) and, when specified, one MLP down_proj column. Round to BF16 RNE. All other weights remain W0. No fitted directions or output-head edits.

control_matching.rule: Reuse the previously registered head24 attenuation factors. Enhancement uses the opposite pre-rounding half-dose delta. Report actual BF16 edit norms; do not retune after evaluation.

diagnostics.interpretation: Small margin interactions and answer flips near BF16 ties are descriptive. Whole-layer residuals are not isolated head writes. Neither nonadditivity nor downstream activation changes establish serial mediation.
diagnostics.ordering_checks: L23 captures should remain invariant. The downstream MLP input should match the corresponding head-only intervention, before its output-column edit.
diagnostics.references: Reuse saved single-intervention measurements where the same prompt and capture are available. Mark missing references explicitly rather than substituting another condition.

evaluation.preserve: Keep every evaluated candidate, all wrong-to-wrong changes, regressions, format/truncation counts, protection checks, and repeat discrepancies.
evaluation.selection: Harness automatic best selection only; diagnostics never rescore candidates.

final_audit.completion: Verify 50 distinct nonzero fully evaluated repairs, submit a new mechanism_report about the actual selected best including unsupported findings, then freeze.
final_audit.ids_rule: Audit the actual selected best on this fixed panel, its official changed-answer IDs, and B-188190:subset:T0:B0 plus B-518494:total:T1:B0. Compare complete generations, hashes, and margins against W0; split batches if needed.
